name: B10-0445/2026 (Renew) – The 2026 undemocratic elections to the Russian State Duma and its implications on civil society
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the undemocratic elections in the Russia State Duma and their implications for civil society
part_text:
The European Parliament says Russia's September 2026 State Duma elections were not free or fair and refuses to accept the new Duma as legitimate. It asks the EU to keep avoiding normal contacts with that body, to sanction more officials behind the crackdown, and to fund Russian exile media, rights defenders and anti-war groups. It also calls for the release of political prisoners, action against Russian repression abroad, and humanitarian visas for dissidents.

- The EU is asked to keep shunning the new Duma and sanction more Russian officials.
- Russian exiles, journalists and rights defenders would get EU funding and visas.
- EU states are urged to act against Russian threats and arrests abroad.
